newsitem.title: UK: AMI Express offers next day service to all America.
newsitem.headline: AMI Express offers next day service to all America.

text.p: AMI Quality Express (AMI QE) said it has launched a new service which will reach all the Americas from its Heathrow base.
The "Total Americas" package will provide next day services to all the U.S., main Canadian cities as well as South America and the Caribbean, it added in a statement.
AMI QE is the express division of the Air Menzies wholesale forwarding group.
UK customers can use late close-outs with free trucking into AMI QE's Heathrow headquarters for the new service.

The South American and Caribbean centres covered by AMI are Buenos Aires, Santiago, Montevideo, Mexico City, Santo Domingo in the Dominican Republic, Port au Prince in Haiti and Nassau in the Bahamas, a spokeswoman said.

The company added that the new product is the latest, but by no means the last, of a series of planned moves to strengthen its position as a leader in the wholesale express market. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
